change: Only skip millisecond resolution busy probe for WASI/no-PFS/monotonic/no-runtime-cycles; set nominal resolution1. Keep SQL selection fix, availability and frequencies.
metadata_policy: resolution1 is the nominal integer millisecond unit, not a calibrated hardware/scheduler claim. Unavailable clocks retain zero metadata.

followup_measurement.requires: successful bound guest build, fresh strict CRC/ownership binding review, actual ANALYZE/SELECT/two-child/cleanup PASS
followup_measurement.fresh_fork: same Go version/host; alternating arms; six batches per arm; report wall and CPU p50/p95
followup_measurement.whole_suite: Go Pipe shop70 at P4 and P8, one warmup plus five alternating pairs each; retain all tails; same SQL/16MiB/read1/admission cap
followup_measurement.baseline: No comparisons against the old broken-clock guest as if the difference were calibration-only.
followup_measurement.stop: Correctness failure or no measurable Fork/overall benefit: record evidence, no automatic adoption.
